_mission_state: THE MEASURED MISSION STATE OF THIS FIXTURE. Constrictor.oolite-save is a PRE-MISSION save: mission_conhunt is ABSENT from its mission_variables dict, because oolite-constrictor-hunt-mission.js only sets conhunt='STAGE_1' once player.score > 255 and this commander sits at EXACTLY 255. Absence is therefore the correct, measured value and is asserted as such; see expected_mission_conhunt below and the README. The absence is paired with expected_live_mission_handlers, which is what makes it a POSITIVE mission-state assertion rather than the mere lack of a field.
_control: The differential control arm. Loading control_save into the IDENTICAL scenario must move every field named here, which is what proves the dump measures the LOADED SAVE and not merely 'a game started'.
_fresh: The second control arm: a game launched with NO -load at all. Measured on this box; every one of these differs from the loaded values above.
